steps.text: Talk to Rantz in the east of Feldip Hills.
Get some achey tree logs near Rantz.
Use your knife on the achey logs to make arrow shafts.
Use the feathers on the arrow shafts.

items.name: Ogre arrow shafts (make more for later)

steps.text: Use a chisel on some wolf bones.
Add the bone arrow tips to the flighted ogre arrows.
Use at least 6 ogre arrows on Rantz.
Ask Rantz all the available questions.
choices: How do we make the chompys come?

steps.text: Enter Rantz's cave.
Open the chest in the cave for some ogre bellows.
Leave the cave.
Fill the bellows on swamp bubbles.
Inflate 3 toads near the swamp.
Bring the toads to Rantz.
Drop the bloated toad in the clearing south of Rantz.
Wait for a chompy to spawn. If the frog despawns, you'll need to place another one in the clearing south of Rantz.
Talk to Rantz again for an ogre bow.
choices: Come on, let me have a go...
I'm actually quite strong... please let me try.

steps.text: Drop another bloated toad in the clearing south of Rantz, and wait for a chompy to come.
Kill the chompy. You can only hurt it with an ogre bow + ogre arrows.
Pluck the chompy.
Talk to Rantz in the east of Feldip Hills.
Enter Rantz's cave.
Talk to Fycie.
Talk to Bugs.
Leave the cave.
Pick a potato south east of Rantz.
Pick an onion from west of Rantz.
Get a tomato from west of Rantz.
Get some equa leaves from south east of Rantz.
Get some doogle leaves from west of Rantz.
Get some cabbage from west of Rantz.
Collect the ingredients Rantz and his children want for the chompy.
Cook the chompy on Rantz's spit-roast.
Bring Rantz the seasoned chompy to finish the quest.

rewards: The ability to fletch Ogre Arrows.
The ability to hunt and cook Chompy Birds.
